summary.headline: Horoscopic Questions, Entries 530–550
summary.text: Catalog entries 530–550 from a Venetian codex, covering stellar aspects, luminary conjunctions, Taurus degrees and zodiacal signs, buildings, imprisonment, letters, travel, inheritance, slaves, adversaries, theft, age, and related horoscopic questions. Entry 538 cites the quadrants of Paulus Alexandrinus, with cross-references to entries 540, 547–549 and folio 193.
